facts.business: The company appears to be a non-operational entity with no business revenue generated for a long time, formerly known as Shashank Traders Limited and now Cosmic Energy & Motors Limited.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on other matters: (i) Investment of Rs. 241.40 lacs in unlisted equity shares recorded at cost without fair value determination per IND AS 109; (ii) Debit/credit balances subject to party confirmations; (iii) Two inoperative bank accounts with all transactions routed through Managing Director's loan account; (iv) No business revenue generated for a long time; (v) No movement in majority of assets and liabilities accounts for a long time.

key_risks: No business revenue generated for a long time
Majority of assets and liabilities accounts show no movement for a long time
All business receipts and payments routed through Managing Director's personal loan account
Bank accounts inoperative for a long time
Investment fair value not determined as required by IND AS 109
Debit and credit balances subject to confirmation from parties
facts.related_party_note: All business receipts and payments of the company have been routed through loan account of Managing Director Sh. Praveen Jain.
